citations.claim: At first violating step 29 controller force 486.9 exceeds fmax 72.67; controlled body velocity jumped after collision
One step before, bodies 0-1 in contact with gap 0.005 and controlled body speed only 2.9 with normal force 6.5
System energy dominated by fast impactor before collision

counterfactual.change: Removed the fast impactor body 1, keeping controller, waypoint, dt, steps identical; controlled body then tracks normally with no force violation.

explanation: Controlled hover body 0 is struck by fast body 1 around step 28 (touching pair gap 0.005, body 0 speed 2.9). The collision impulse abruptly changes body 0 velocity to speed 10.27 at step 29 (vx -5.87, vy 8.42). The controller velocity-error law kp*(vDesired-vActual) then demands ~487 N, far above fmax 72.67, so the fmax clamp is missing/not applied on this post-collision update path.
vision_note: A small red circle falls toward a larger blue circle near a waypoint and touches it at step 28. At step 29 the two separate with the red deflected left and the blue pushed right, showing a collision impulse.
